Distance compares aligned, color-corrected captures of the same phase. We aim for a mostly similar pool with some variation, not the largest possible distance. Severe blur, wrong phase or wrong geometry should not count as useful diversity.

Start the camera; alignment checks run automatically.

Uploads contain calibrated pixels, device/browser/camera metadata and optional original PNGs. Recording stays local until you press Upload. Downloads remain available. Each batch contains one grid size; upload or download it before clearing. The physical session and split remain fixed across batches. Collection is capped at 128 samples and 160 MiB; the per-phase maximum is reduced for large grids or many phases so every phase can fit. For G256 with four phases, start with six samples per phase. Browser memory use is higher than the JSON size.
